nodes.label: Domain I · Freedom from Waste
nodes.question: reduce involuntary exposure to residual burdens without transferring them

nodes.label: Domain II · Material Afterlives
nodes.question: when does "no longer needed by me" become "available for another"

nodes.label: Domain III · Ecological Flourishing
nodes.question: conditions that let ecological systems regenerate

nodes.label: Frame B · residuals that refuse regeneration

nodes.label: Capacity chain / no public evidence system
Central Environmental Authority
nodes.src: anavaratha-legacy/raw/waste_cycles_anavaratha/zip_entries/Anavaratha Enforcement Institution and Capacity Map v0.1.md §Institutional map
nodes.role: Administer environmental law and regulations; set standards; coordinate pollution regulation; inspect, investigate complaints, issue or oversee directions and licences; require local authorities to act
nodes.capacity_needed: Inspectors, laboratories, legal officers, transport, complaint systems, case management, data, budget, follow-up
nodes.evidence_to_seek: Staffing, inspections, notices, licences, complaints, prosecutions, laboratory records, annual reports

nodes.label: Ministry of Environment
nodes.src: anavaratha-legacy/raw/waste_cycles_anavaratha/zip_entries/Anavaratha Enforcement Institution and Capacity Map v0.1.md §Institutional map
nodes.role: Policy, national action plans, coordination, steering and monitoring architecture
nodes.capacity_needed: Policy implementation unit, cross-agency coordination, budget, reporting and review
nodes.evidence_to_seek: Action-plan progress reports, committee minutes, budgets, KPI records

nodes.label: Municipal councils, urban councils, and pradeshiya sabhas
nodes.src: anavaratha-legacy/raw/waste_cycles_anavaratha/zip_entries/Anavaratha Enforcement Institution and Capacity Map v0.1.md §Institutional map
nodes.role: Local waste collection, transport, disposal, local services, local by-laws and operational decisions
nodes.capacity_needed: Vehicles, drivers, fuel, routes, staff, land, facilities, procurement, recurrent finance, public communication
nodes.evidence_to_seek: Collection logs, route sheets, vehicle downtime, payroll, budgets, council minutes, disposal records

nodes.label: Western Province Waste Management Authority or equivalent provincial body
nodes.src: anavaratha-legacy/raw/waste_cycles_anavaratha/zip_entries/Anavaratha Enforcement Institution and Capacity Map v0.1.md §Institutional map
nodes.role: Provincial coordination, waste-management programs, technical and oversight functions
nodes.capacity_needed: Technical staff, coordination authority, project finance, data integration, enforcement escalation
nodes.evidence_to_seek: Province-wide plans, reports, facility oversight, directions, monitoring and budgets

nodes.label: Urban Development Authority and land authorities
nodes.src: anavaratha-legacy/raw/waste_cycles_anavaratha/zip_entries/Anavaratha Enforcement Institution and Capacity Map v0.1.md §Institutional map
nodes.role: Land allocation, development permissions, spatial planning, and land-use decisions that affect disposal sites
nodes.capacity_needed: Land records, planning review, environmental safeguards, monitoring, enforcement
nodes.evidence_to_seek: Allocations, approvals, conditions, maps, inspection reports

nodes.label: Divisional and district administration
nodes.src: anavaratha-legacy/raw/waste_cycles_anavaratha/zip_entries/Anavaratha Enforcement Institution and Capacity Map v0.1.md §Institutional map
nodes.role: Administrative coordination and district-level agencies; District Environmental Agency structure under the Act
nodes.capacity_needed: Convening authority, records, coordination, complaint escalation
nodes.evidence_to_seek: District agency records, minutes, referrals, inspections

nodes.label: Police
nodes.src: anavaratha-legacy/raw/waste_cycles_anavaratha/zip_entries/Anavaratha Enforcement Institution and Capacity Map v0.1.md §Institutional map
nodes.role: Criminal investigation and support where offences, obstruction, public order, or other criminal conduct is involved
nodes.capacity_needed: Investigation, evidence preservation, transport, staffing, coordination with regulators and courts
nodes.evidence_to_seek: Complaints, entries, case files, arrests, charges, evidence chain

nodes.label: Magistrate’s Courts
nodes.src: anavaratha-legacy/raw/waste_cycles_anavaratha/zip_entries/Anavaratha Enforcement Institution and Capacity Map v0.1.md §Institutional map
nodes.role: Summary trials and orders under environmental offences; fines, imprisonment, continuing fines, corrective and restoration orders where authorized
nodes.capacity_needed: Timely case listing, evidence assessment, enforceable orders, records, monitoring of compliance
nodes.evidence_to_seek: Case numbers, charges, decisions, sentences, payment, restoration orders

nodes.label: Forest, wildlife, wetland, and conservation agencies
nodes.src: anavaratha-legacy/raw/waste_cycles_anavaratha/zip_entries/Anavaratha Enforcement Institution and Capacity Map v0.1.md §Institutional map
nodes.role: Protection of ecological receptors and protected areas; approvals, monitoring, and referrals
nodes.capacity_needed: Rangers, ecological monitoring, maps, boundary data, legal coordination
nodes.evidence_to_seek: Site records, permits, complaints, species/ecosystem monitoring, referrals

nodes.label: Informal collectors, community organizations, and private operators
nodes.src: anavaratha-legacy/raw/waste_cycles_anavaratha/zip_entries/Anavaratha Enforcement Institution and Capacity Map v0.1.md §Institutional map
nodes.role: Recovery, collection, sorting, transport, market linkage, local monitoring
nodes.capacity_needed: Safe working conditions, buyer access, equipment, legal recognition, data capture
nodes.evidence_to_seek: Purchase records, route evidence, worker surveys, contracts, output records

nodes.label: Courts, public-interest organizations, and affected communities
nodes.src: anavaratha-legacy/raw/waste_cycles_anavaratha/zip_entries/Anavaratha Enforcement Institution and Capacity Map v0.1.md §Institutional map
nodes.role: Accountability, litigation, complaints, evidence generation, and remedy claims
nodes.capacity_needed: Access to information, legal support, documentation, public voice
nodes.evidence_to_seek: Petitions, judgments, photographs, testimonies, monitoring reports
